in_marathi.name: Gandhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gandhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds the weapon of truth, a peaceful warrior. In Hindu mythology, Gandhi is a title given to sages and warriors who have mastered their inner battles, leading to spiritual peace and enlightenment.
